name: job-scan
title: Job Scan
summary: An automated job search on a Slipdock board: a daily scan scores roles against your own rules, and documents are built when you ask.
author: Slipdock

requires.connector: the Slipdock connector (MCP) or the slipdock CLI
requires.for_scanning: a browser the agent can drive, signed in to the job sites you search
requires.for_documents: a runner on pool default, or a scheduled task that claims its jobs
